settings.title: Confidence Starts With Daily Care
settings.body: Hair fall isn't just about hair — it's about how you feel every time you look in the mirror. Reniva fits into the routine you already have, working quietly in the background so you can focus on showing up as your most confident self.

settings.question: Is Reniva safe for color-treated or chemically treated hair?
settings.answer: Yes. Reniva is formulated without harsh sulfates, so it's gentle enough for color-treated, keratin-treated, or chemically processed hair. As with any new product, we recommend a small patch test first if you have particularly sensitive skin.

settings.question: How long until I see results?
settings.answer: Most people notice reduced hair fall within 2–4 weeks of consistent use. Visible improvements in thickness and strength typically build over 8–12 weeks, since hair growth cycles take time.

settings.question: Is Reniva suitable for both men and women?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Reniva's botanical formula is designed to work for all genders and hair types, addressing hair fall and scalp health regardless of who's using it.

settings.question: Will Reniva help with dandruff too?
settings.answer: Yes. Ingredients like Thuja Orientalis and Ginger Extract help calm an irritated, flaky scalp, so many customers see improvements in dandruff alongside reduced hair fall.

settings.question: What's inside each pouch?
settings.answer: Each pouch contains 300ml of shampoo formulated with Thuja Orientalis, Hydrolyzed Oat Protein, Ginger Extract, Ginseng Extract, and Jojoba Oil — free from harsh sulfates and parabens.

settings.question: Is this a one-time purchase or a subscription?
settings.answer: Reniva is available as a simple one-time purchase, so you're never locked into a recurring plan. You can reorder whenever you're ready for your next pouch.

settings.title: For Your Scalp's Future
